meta.repo_description: Electron desktop AI interview assistant — JS/CJS, node:test, 27 tests
meta.author: Velora / Quarterback project
meta.note: Legacy development tasks (QB-30): tuned during development; dev split only; never part of a holdout. Ungraded until each has a frozen qb-task-spec/1.

tasks.description: Add a getProviderName() function to src/llm.js that returns the currently active LLM provider name as a string
tasks.note: Reference task — previously tested and confirmed passing

tasks.description: Add a formatDuration(ms) function to src/wav.js that converts a millisecond count to a human-readable string like '1m 23s' or '45s'
tasks.note: Pure utility function, no state, no imports needed

tasks.description: Add an isAvailable() method to the STT object returned by createSTT() in src/stt.js that returns true when at least one provider has an API key configured
tasks.note: Tests whether agent reads the existing createSTT() return object pattern

tasks.description: Add a getErrorSummary(error) helper function to src/llm.js that returns a short one-line string summarising an LLM error: include the provider name, HTTP status if present, and whether it was a rate limit
tasks.note: Requires reading existing formatProviderErrorMessage() and normalizeProviderName() to avoid duplication

tasks.description: Add a getVADStats() function to src/vad.js that returns an object with speechCount (number of speech events detected) and totalSpeechMs (cumulative ms of detected speech) tracked since the AdaptiveVAD was created
tasks.note: Requires modifying the existing AdaptiveVAD class to accumulate counters

tasks.description: Add a formatBytes(bytes) utility function to src/wav.js that converts a byte count to a human-readable string like '1.2 MB' or '340 KB', then export it and import and use it in main.js to log the PCM buffer size before each STT flush
tasks.note: Multi-file task — tests whether agent correctly updates both files and the export
